From: Legal Team <legal@timbercloud.com>

Cc: procurement@timbercloud.com
Date: 2025-11-06T10:28:00-08:00
Subject: TimberCloud redlines to Redwood DPA (high-level issues)

Karthik —

Attached are our annotated redlines. High-level items:

1) Subprocessor notification: We prefer a 10-day notice window with a 7-day objection period for any new subprocessor that will access EU personal data. 30 days is long for our procurement/compliance timelines.

2) Objection resolution: We ask for a clearer escalation path (procurement -> legal -> CISO) and a commitment to pause onboarding pending resolution for high-risk processors.

3) Data transfers: Please confirm we will execute SCCs and include a signed copy as part of the DPA package.

We are not requesting changes to core liability limits but need the above operational clarifications to sign.

Attaching: TimberCloud_DPA_Redlines_20251106.pdf

Emma Guest
on behalf of TimberCloud Legal

Short timeline from TimberCloud — they asked to finish legal review this week.

Thanks,
Karthik

Karthik —

Thanks for the ping. Proposed approach (clearly articulated in the DPA response):

1) Notification window: Keep our standard 30-day notice but add an explicit "expedited notice" option that triggers a 10-day operational review for subprocessors that will access or process EU personal data or high-sensitivity categories (health, financial). This preserves our release cadence while addressing their risk timeline.

2) Objection & pause: We can commit to an escalation path (procurement -> legal -> CISO) and to a temporary pause on onboarding only for processors that present unresolved security/privacy risks. The pause will be limited (max 10 business days) while we work in good faith.

3) Data transfers: Confirm SCCs. I’ll prepare a signature-ready SCC addendum to attach to the DPA.

If you approve, I’ll prepare a short cover email and return a version for DocuSign that incorporates those clauses. Also attaching a one-page note for the account team summarizing the subprocessor objection playbook.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Privacy Counsel | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
